headline: Sánchez avoids references to the housing decree and puts the focus on the regions: "Residential use must be prioritized"
summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez asked regions to use the tools of the state Housing Law. He said residential use must be prioritised.
why: Housing rules affect rental supply, property values and the investment case for residential real estate in Spain.

original_headline: Sánchez evita referencias al decreto de vivienda y pone el foco sobre las autonomías: "Hay que priorizar el uso residencial"
